jobs.1566c74f8070: Closing quotation mark right after a quoted sentence's final word (comma inside the quote), before an attribution verb like 'said' or 'says' in news quotes.
jobs.d65e5a185e59: Opening bracket or parenthesis token (' (' or ' [') placed right after a noun phrase, introducing an abbreviation, date, gloss or editorial insertion.
jobs.a3cc0f7dabbe: Token just before a colon that opens a bulleted list in medical or reference text, often a verb like ' include' or a list-introducing noun; also digits and word pieces.
jobs.a6285dc74f70: Final token of a person's name or noun phrase (surname piece, ' others', ' colleagues', ' children') that completes the subject, mostly in names and 'X and others'.
jobs.9e5b5e842733: Token very near the start of a document: the comma or word right after an opening time phrase, or first name pieces in a byline or headline.
jobs.4ea0df639cfd: Start of a sentence after a newline: an opening quote mark or ' to' after 'According'; also quote-initial 'This'/'The' beginning a quoted statement.
jobs.0e12398a20ba: Question mark ending a rhetorical question, or ' is'/colon after 'the answer'/'short answer', where the answer to a posed question comes next.
jobs.7258ababc16d: Word or word piece in the middle of a multi-token term, where the next token finishes the word or phrase (e.g. 'some irregular|ities', 'machine translation'); no single token type.
jobs.58071dfacd1c: Function word ' the' (also ' of', ' and', ' in') inside geographic or historical prose, just before a proper noun naming a place, people or empire.
jobs.2b16a12875fa: ' just' or ' are' after a plural list of examples, in the phrase 'X, Y and Z are just a few/some of'; also 'Here are'.
jobs.033180147c47: Final digit or unit letter of a number, date, citation or abbreviation, e.g. year digits, scripture verse numbers, 'B.C', units like 'm/s'.
jobs.579a96618069: Middle or last piece of a split foreign or rare proper name or year (e.g. 'Fun|an', 'Mal|uku', '17|9|3'), where the token continues an unfamiliar name.
jobs.a0b420c1c0ff: Second or third token in the first line of a document (title or headline), often the word after 'How do/can', a leading noun, or ' to' in a title.
jobs.d7f2b821d289: Newline token that ends a short header, site breadcrumb or boilerplate line at the very start of a page, just before the article body begins.
jobs.657c4919a5b5: Opening parenthesis ' (' or table cell separator '||' following a name, place or figure, introducing a date, area, or value in biographical and infobox text.
jobs.d2367b73256e: Mid-word subword token inside a long technical or scientific word split across tokens (e.g. 'chi-s|quared', 'pp|G|pp', 'immunos|up|pression'), plus object nouns in technical lists.
jobs.39f48ab8719d: Final token of a boilerplate or metadata fragment (' OK', ' above', closing ')', last digit of a date, '</a'), right before the text moves to something else.
jobs.6c1160cfe881: Weak, diffuse: a function word (' of', ' a', ' and', ' is') early in a title or first sentence of a web page; top window is ' today' in "in today's".
jobs.924dc0e0de8d: The word ' of' inside an organization or journal name, right after 'Association', 'Society', 'Council', 'Union' or 'Journal', before the field it covers.
jobs.9cabda4d6732: Word that begins a hyphenated or titled compound whose next token is a hyphen or a name: ' Vice' (President/Admiral), ' fellow', 'by', 'printing', ' House' (Wren).
jobs.40ee35676ed0: Verb, preposition or adjective that sits right before its object noun phrase in academic prose: ' investigate', ' use', ' look at', ' novel', ' learned'.
jobs.43dc60cdc8ac: Verb or article following an organization or group subject in policy and news text, such as ' called', ' adopted', ' have', ' a', or ' of' in 'Council of'.
jobs.6bd62a966d11: unclear: mostly a middle word piece or function word in educational text ('euc|aly|ptus', 'de|hydr|ated', ' also known'); one window far above the rest.
jobs.07b4d290ddf1: Token inside a quoted or scare-quoted word, or a middle piece of a rare word, such as '"|faces|', '"solve"', ' of' in dates like '18th of July'.
jobs.65463b79047d: Colon or period followed by newline that ends a sentence introducing the next block; also word pieces inside rare words ('Brucellos|is', 'Vacc|ines').
jobs.631eef33f18c: Token right after a dateline, byline or numbered item at the very start of a document: ':' or ' —' after a city, a newline after a date, '1.' period, ' than' after 'More'.
jobs.c9e925b70130: Sentence-final period (often with newline) in opinion and news prose, or the first word ('And', 'But', 'More') of the next sentence starting a paragraph.
jobs.0034bb4b46cc: Newline token at the end of a header line or sentence: after 'Article Free Pass', URLs, dates, or a period or colon before a bulleted list.
jobs.b22a21e8e3db: Word-initial prefix piece (' inter', ' per', 'Expl', ' cr', 'B') that starts a longer word, such as 'inter|play', 'inter|laced', 'per|secution', 'Expl|oring'.
jobs.ad0e18e53dbc: Sentence-ending period (often followed by newline) or comma at the end of a vivid narrative or reflective clause in essays and stories, before a new sentence begins.
